subject.title: [Feature]: Show additional information in `openclaw devices list`

question: Should this issue remain the broad tracker for paired-device metadata/detail UX after the rename slice, or should it be narrowed to specific `openclaw devices list` columns and a detail mode?
rationale: Current main stores much of the metadata but does not surface it, and the requested UX overlaps the open rename PR plus the separate human-friendly naming issue.

options.title: Coordinate broad metadata UX
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and define sanitized client, platform, activity, default-device, and detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

options.title: Narrow to CLI columns
options.body: Limit this issue to client/platform/activity columns and a possible `--full` mode, leaving labels, notes, and UI rename behavior to separate items.

options.title: Treat rename as enough
options.body: Close or narrow this issue once the rename PR lands, accepting that richer client/platform/activity/detail output is outside current product direction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate broad metadata UX
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and define sanitized client, platform, activity, default-device, and detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest observed history across device auth/pairing, the devices CLI, and prior review framing for this issue's product boundary.
